items.description: A major city in northern Salta, known for its agro-industrial importance and jungle surroundings.
A city in northern Salta province, known for its strategic location and regional oil/gas activity.
The capital of San Juan province, known for its modern architecture and prominent wine and olive industries.
The capital of San Luis province, a historic city situated at the foot of the San Luis mountain range.
A major industrial city in San Luis, known for its manufacturing and central location in the region.
The capital of Santa Cruz province, a windswept city located near the Atlantic coast in Southern Patagonia.
The capital of Santa Fe province, situated near the Paraná and Salado rivers, with rich colonial heritage.
A major port city on the Paraná River, known as the birthplace of the Argentine flag and home to Che Guevara.
The oldest city in Argentina, known for its rich colonial history and ancient architecture.
The southernmost city in the world, located in Tierra del Fuego, known as the gateway to Antarctica.
